title: The Rest of US — Hub registry
description: The registry (hubs.json) that lists every hub a node searches. Each hub is an independent profile feed, usually a GitHub Pages site built from a hub repository. Health data is not stored here: the daily aggregate-hubs workflow writes it to aggregated-directory.json, so this file only changes when a person edits it.

name.description: Shown when other nodes list this registry as a peer.

profile_schema.description: Path or URL of the profile schema hubs in this registry follow.

peers.description: Other nodes' hubs.json URLs. Followed one level deep.

repository.description: owner/repo that receives profile pull requests.

path.description: Folder in that repository where profile files go.

id.description: Unique within this registry. Used in profile links (#profile=<id>:<profile>).

profiles_url.description: The hub's feed: an absolute https:// URL, or a path relative to this hubs.json for hubs hosted in the same repository.

status.description: active: fetched and searched. planned: listed as coming soon, not fetched. demo: fetched, labelled as samples. disabled: ignored.

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames of the hub's volunteer reviewers.

max_members.description: Optional size cap the hub enforces on itself (hub-template defaults to 8).

always_open.description: Receives submissions for regions without an open hub.
